newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia end-March palm oil stocks put at 618,000T.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia end-March palm oil stocks put at 618,000T.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks are expected to fall to 618,000 tonnes at end-March from 793,000 tonnes at end-December 1996, the U.S. embassy said on Wednesday.
Stocks were at 699,000 tonnes at the end of March last year.

"With lower domestic crude palm oil (CPO) output anticipated during the January-March period, the palm oil stock level is expected to drop to around 620,000 tonnes at the end of March," it said in a report prepared by the U.S. agricultural attache in Kuala Lumpur.
The embassy said that the industry is expecting a further drop of around 10 percent in CPO production in January.
It added that a tight supply situation supported the surge in CPO prices last month.
"The average monthly CPO prices for January was 1,319 ringgit a tonne," it said.
It expects prices to remain strong with stocks slipping to lower levels over the next couple of months.
The embassy said CPO output in 1996 totalled 8.4 million tonnes versus 7.8 million tonnes in 1995.
